prompt: I want to add a new 'always on top' setting to the Qobuz-Player app. The user should be able to toggle it from the settings overlay. Look at the existing Settings struct in settings.rs and the settings.html overlay to understand the pattern, then tell me exactly what files need to change and what the changes would look like.

assertions.name: mentions-settings-rs-field
assertions.description: Answer mentions adding `always_on_top: bool` field to the Settings struct in settings.rs

assertions.name: mentions-settings-html-checkbox
assertions.description: Answer mentions adding a checkbox UI element in settings.html for the always-on-top setting

assertions.name: mentions-main-rs-save-handler
assertions.description: Answer mentions adding logic to main.rs save_settings command to apply the setting via window.set_always_on_top()

assertions.name: mentions-main-rs-startup
assertions.description: Answer mentions applying the setting at startup in the setup closure (not just on save)

assertions.name: mentions-save-settings-apphandle
assertions.description: Answer correctly identifies that save_settings needs app: tauri::AppHandle parameter added
